pricing:
Pricing (USD), effective October 2026; the pilot price from 24 October 2026. Final terms are set in a licence agreement signed by AugustInnovations LLC.

90-DAY PILOT — $9,500 flat
Single program site. Onboarding, BAA and QSOA, and CalOMS code-set validation against the DHCS dictionary included; file layout confirmed with your county, and your county or provider submits the file (SUDS sends nothing to DHCS). Less per month than the Program plan, and credited in full toward the first annual plan.

PROGRAM — $24,500 / year
Single site, up to 30 staff accounts. BAA and QSOA, hosting on a dedicated server of its own, all updates, and email support included.

MULTI-SITE — $49,500 / year
Up to 5 sites, up to 150 staff accounts. Everything in Program, plus onboarding assistance.

COUNTY-WIDE — $98,000 / year
Unlimited sites and staff within one county. Everything in Multi-Site, plus onboarding, training, and a named support contact.

Hosting is single-tenant: each customer runs in its own isolated instance, with its own database and encryption keys, on a server of its own — never a shared database or server. The GitHub Pages build stays free at its official address. Prices exclude customer infrastructure for self-hosted office servers.
sla: Paid plans: email support with a response within 2 business days. Security fixes ship as patches as soon as they are verified. No uptime commitment is made for office servers running on customer infrastructure; the GitHub Pages build is provided as-is.
